resources.string: Save the sign-in you use on the app you capture from. During a run this app can enter it and tap Login for you.
Sign me in during a run
On. The saved mPIN is typed and Login is tapped.
On. The saved password is typed and Login is tapped.
Off. You sign in on the login screen yourself.
One try per run, whichever method you pick. Three wrong tries in a row can lock the account, so a rejected sign-in switches this off instead of trying again.
The login screen opens on mPIN. Pick Password and the app taps “Try using Password” before it types.
At least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, a number and a special character.
Four digits, the same ones you type on the login screen.
At least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, a number and a special character.
Use at least 8 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, a number and a special character.
Stored encrypted on this phone only. Never exported, uploaded or written to a diagnostic log.
Password must have at least 8 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, a number and a special character.
That mPIN was rejected, so automatic sign-in was switched off. Correct it and save to turn it back on.
That password was rejected, so automatic sign-in was switched off. Correct it and save to turn it back on.
The saved mPIN was rejected. Automatic sign-in is off — sign in by hand and save the new mPIN.
The saved password was rejected. Automatic sign-in is off — sign in by hand and save the new password.
Typed for you when a capture run meets the login screen.
Save the same four digits you type on the login screen.
Come back here the moment you change the mPIN in the app.
Sign in by hand once after saving, so you know the digits are right.
Don\u2019t leave a stale mPIN saved. It gets one try per run, and three wrong tries in a row lock the account.
Don\u2019t save it on a phone other people unlock.
Don\u2019t guess. Remove it instead and type it yourself.
Use at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, a number and a special character.
Re-save here after every password change.
Sign in by hand once after saving, so you know it is right.
Don\u2019t leave an old password saved. A wrong one is one of the three tries that lock the account.
Don\u2019t save it on a phone other people unlock.
Don\u2019t guess. Remove it instead and type it yourself.
Update this whenever you change it in the app.
Deletes the four digits from this phone and switches automatic sign-in off. Nothing changes in the app itself — you type the mPIN on the login screen yourself until you save it here again.
Deletes the password from this phone and switches automatic sign-in off. Nothing changes in the app itself — you type the password on the login screen yourself until you save it here again.
